boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten admission-free museum hangs in Washington, verified through current official Smithsonian visitor information.

cards.entity_name: National Museum of African American History and Culture
cards.title: Trace Black History Together
cards.subtitle: A free museum hang on Constitution Avenue
cards.notes: Reserve free timed-entry passes, meet beneath the bronze exterior, and compare which history or culture gallery resonates most with everyone.
cards.short_summary: Explore African American history and culture as a group, then trade reflections after the galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian identifies the museum at 1400 Constitution Avenue NW and states that admission is free with timed-entry passes required.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo: Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: Free timed-entry passes are required; reserve through the Smithsonian before traveling.

cards.title: Run an American History Object Hunt
cards.subtitle: Choose themes and compare discoveries
cards.notes: Pick a shared theme—music, technology, protest, or everyday life—then split up briefly and reconvene to show one memorable object each.
cards.short_summary: Turn a free history-museum visit into a collaborative search across American stories.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the National Museum of American History at 1300 Constitution Avenue NW as free, with no passes needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo: Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no entry pass is needed; check the official page for operating updates.

cards.title: Make a Natural History Gallery Loop
cards.subtitle: Fossils, gems, and wildlife without a ticket
cards.notes: Choose two galleries together, pause for everyone’s favorite specimen, and finish by sharing the strangest fact each person learned.
cards.short_summary: Build an easy group outing around specimens from the natural world and human history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the National Museum of Natural History at 10th Street and Constitution Avenue NW as free, with no passes needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo: Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no entry pass is needed; allow time for security screening.

cards.entity_name: National Museum of the American Indian
cards.title: Compare Indigenous Stories in the Galleries
cards.subtitle: A conversation-led visit near the National Mall
cards.notes: Move through one exhibition at a relaxed pace, read labels closely, and regroup afterward to discuss whose voice shaped each presentation.
cards.short_summary: Use a no-cost gallery visit to engage with Native heritage, history, and contemporary voices.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the National Museum of the American Indian in Washington at 4th Street and Independence Avenue SW as free, with no passes needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo: Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no entry pass is needed; check current exhibitions before visiting.

cards.title: Pick a Dream Air-and-Space Mission
cards.subtitle: Free flight history with advance planning
cards.notes: Reserve the group’s free passes, explore the aircraft and spacecraft, then have everyone choose the mission they would most want to join.
cards.short_summary: Make aerospace history social by debating which aircraft or space mission earns the group’s vote.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian identifies the National Air and Space Museum at 650 Jefferson Drive SW and states that entry is free with timed-entry passes required.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo: Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: Free timed-entry passes are required; secure passes from the Smithsonian for every member of the group.

cards.title: Trade One-Minute Art Reactions
cards.subtitle: Modern art as a group conversation starter
cards.notes: Choose several works, give each person one uninterrupted minute to react, and let the artist’s materials or choices guide the discussion.
cards.short_summary: Turn contemporary art into a playful, low-pressure exchange of interpretations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian includes the Hirshhorn Museum and Sculpture Garden among its Washington museums and states that Smithsonian museum admission is free except at Cooper Hewitt in New York.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo: Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: Admission is free; consult the official visitor page for current hours and any gallery closures.

cards.title: Try an African Art Detail Challenge
cards.subtitle: Look closely across centuries of art
cards.notes: Let each person select one surprising detail, material, or pattern, then guide the group back to the work without naming it first.
cards.short_summary: Practice close looking together while exploring art from across the African continent and diaspora.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the National Museum of African Art at 950 Independence Avenue SW as free, with no passes needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo: Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no entry pass is needed; verify current hours before departure.

cards.title: Walk the Museum’s East and West Buildings
cards.subtitle: Two connected settings for Asian art
cards.notes: Start in one building, cross to the other, and ask everyone to identify a work that changed how they understood a place or period.
cards.short_summary: Connect ancient and contemporary perspectives during a free two-building art walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists both buildings of the National Museum of Asian Art in Washington as free, with no passes needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo: Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no entry pass is needed; the museum occupies adjoining East and West buildings.

cards.title: Swap Stories Inspired by American Art
cards.subtitle: An admission-free downtown gallery session
cards.notes: Choose a portrait, landscape, or abstract work, invent a brief backstory, and compare it with the museum label before moving on.
cards.short_summary: Use American artworks as prompts for a creative group storytelling session.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s official visitor page says admission is always free, tickets are not required, and its main building is at 8th and G Streets NW.
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free and tickets are not required; some galleries may be temporarily closed during renovations.

cards.title: Build a Group Portrait Theme
cards.subtitle: Find faces connected by one shared idea
cards.notes: Agree on a theme such as leadership, creativity, or public service, then have each person nominate one portrait and explain the link.
cards.short_summary: Create a collective mini-exhibition by connecting portraits through a theme the group chooses.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the National Portrait Gallery at 8th and G Streets NW as free, with no passes needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo: Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no entry pass is needed; visitors enter a shared building with the American Art Museum.
